task.title: Turn the trade board into a page that loads its report
task.description:
## Why
The board is one HTML file with a run's data baked in. On the site it should be one page shared by everyone that loads a report's data by address.

## Steps
1. Split `rebuild/templates/trade_board.html` into a page, a stylesheet and scripts under `web/`.
2. Replace the baked-in `DATA` with a fetch of the report's board data, with loading and error states.
3. Keep saving the selected team and trade in the browser's `localStorage`, keyed by league id.
4. Use one copy of the value-curve and lineup-cost logic from `board_weights.js` in both the board and the engine.
5. Keep `tests/board_weights.test.js` passing against the shared copy.
6. Host the fonts with the site or keep the Google Fonts link, and record which was chosen.

## Done when
- The board for a fixture's report looks and behaves the same as the CLI's `trade-board.html`: custom trades, All deals, League trades and custom league weights.
- The board weights tests pass.
